section.45: The Book of Oaths (qasamah), Retaliation and Blood Money

45.name_native: The Book of Oaths (qasamah), Retaliation and Blood Money

hadiths.text: It was narrated from 'Amr bin Shu'aib, from his father, from 'Abdullah bin 'Amr, that the Messenger of Allah said:"The blood money for a disbeliever is half the blood money for the believer." (Hassan)
